title: Kobe — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Kobe.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Quality Ventilation." Specialty tier. Kobe makes stainless steel range hoods focused on quiet operation and strong suction. Popular in the contractor and independent dealer channel.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ventilation needs prioritizing quiet operation. Contractor channel.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Kobe:

• QuietMode technology for extremely low noise

• Strong stainless construction

• Popular with contractors

• Value pricing for quality hoods

• Good suction-to-noise ratio
